door_lock.title: Security Door Lock Interlock System
door_lock.description: Unlocks door only when Keycard Sensor (A) AND Passcode Keypad (B) are both active (1).

motor_enable.title: Industrial Motor Control Safety Interlock
motor_enable.description: Enables conveyor motor only when Safety Shield Closed (A) AND Emergency Stop Not Pressed (B).

alarm_system.title: Burglar Security Alarm Circuit
alarm_system.description: Triggers siren alarm when Window Sensor (A) OR Door Break Sensor (B) detects intrusion.

traffic_light.title: Traffic Light Controller Override Interlock
traffic_light.description: Emergency vehicle override logic preventing simultaneous green light signals.
